title: Play To Earn (P2E)
content:
- ### Definition
  - A blockchain gaming model where players earn cryptocurrency tokens or NFT assets with real-world value through gameplay activities, combining entertainment with financial incentives through decentralized ownership of in-game items and characters.

- ### Semantic Classification
  - owl-class:: spatial-computing:PlayToEarnP2e
  - owl-role:: Concept
  - belongs-to-domain:: [[metaverse]]

- ### Relationships
  - is-subclass-of:: [[Blockchain Gaming]]
  - enables:: [[Digital Asset Ownership]]

- ### Content

  - #### Economic Model
		- Players earn tokens through gameplay activities
		- NFT ownership of characters, items, and land
		- Decentralized marketplaces for trading assets
		- Staking mechanisms for passive income
		- Integration with DeFi protocols
  - #### Market Context
		- Market projected at $8.8B by 2028
		- Q2 2024 investments reached $1.1B (314% increase)
		- Top games: Axie Infinity, The Sandbox, Decentraland
		- Strong adoption in Southeast Asia and Latin America
